name: Advanced Filesystem: AI Transcription
description: Semantic-extraction pipeline for managed files, built on the Drupal AI module. Transcribes audio/video speech-to-text, captions and moderates images, OCRs/reads PDFs and Office documents, extracts named entities and taxonomy tags, and generates vector embeddings for similarity search. Results are stored in adfs_ai_ prefixed fields on the file entity via a pluggable SemanticExtractor plugin type.

suggests.drupal/ai: ^1.0 — provides the ai.provider service; required at runtime for every AI-backed extractor (speech_to_text, chat_with_image_vision, chat, embeddings, object_detection operations). Extractors self-disable when no compatible provider is configured.
suggests.ext-none (ffmpeg/ffprobe binary): required on PATH for audio-track extraction from video and embedded-subtitle reading (TranscriptionService).
suggests.poppler-utils (pdftoppm/pdftotext binari: used by the PDF extractor for native text extraction and rasterisation before AI-vision OCR.
suggests.libreoffice binary: optional CLI fallback used by the Office-document extractor to convert DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/ODF to text.

project_description: The AI Transcription submodule of Advanced Filesystem turns managed files into semantically rich, searchable content by running them through a pluggable extraction pipeline built on the Drupal AI module (drupal/ai). It never talks to an AI provider directly: every call is delegated to the ai.provider plugin manager, so key handling, endpoints and TLS are the provider's responsibility and the module works with any provider that implements the needed operation (OpenAI, Azure, Google Gemini, Ollama, etc.). A SemanticExtractor plugin type (annotation, manager, base class, interface) ships eleven extractors — audio and video speech-to-text (with ffmpeg audio extraction and embedded-subtitle reuse to avoid AI cost), image captioning, object/category/color/brand analysis, face/emotion detection, safety moderation, PDF text extraction/OCR, Office-document text, plain-text extraction with AI enrichment, AI taxonomy tagging, and vector embeddings with optional VDB indexing. A per-MIME-group matrix decides which extractors run for audio, video, image, PDF, text and other files. Extraction runs on demand (per-file form or batch), via Drush, or automatically on upload through a cron QueueWorker. All output lands in adfs_ai_ fields on the file entity, exposed to Views and to Media through an AI Transcription media source, and reviewable per file (transcript, tags, JSON entities, embedding fingerprint and a most-similar-files gallery) or library-wide as a 2D PCA embedding map. Every route is gated behind the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_ai_transcription' permission.
